subject: Redwood quickstart — choose a time that works for your team

Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>

Subject: Welcome to Redwood — get started + pick a demo time

Hi Alex,

Thanks for signing up for a Redwood trial — glad to have you onboard. We created a short onboarding session to walk through: quick account setup, how to test low-latency inference, and the Optimize recommendations for cost.

Pick any 30-minute slot that works for your team: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min
If none of the listed times work, reply to this thread and we’ll coordinate manually.

Quick resources attached: redwood-trial-quickstart.pdf (1.2MB) — includes sample prompts and a checklist.

We’ve copied your assigned rep, Avery Johnson, who can tailor the session if you want a deeper technical dive.

— The Redwood Trials Team
